objective.statement: Decide whether a RUNNING council or work unit has met its stopping floors, and if not, name exactly which floor is unmet.
objective.charter: The meta-council. Two seats, two minutes, transcript state only. It may not re-litigate the question under discussion; its entire output space is STOP, CONTINUE, or DEFER plus the name of the unmet floor. 'We have talked enough' is not an answer - the floor must be named.
success_criteria: either every minimum-deliberation floor is shown met, or the unmet floor is named exactly
the verdict cites transcript state (rounds, positions, open objections), not impressions
no opinion on the underlying question appears in the output

roster.display_name: Methodologist (audits the floors against transcript state)

context.briefing: Read the transcript state only. For each floor in the parent council's stopping.minimum_deliberation, report MET or UNMET with the observed number next to the required one.

expression.producer: stage 'floor-audit': every floor in the PARENT council's stopping.minimum_deliberation is marked MET with an observed value, or exactly one UNMET floor is named
expression.note: Single-leaf rule, and deliberately self-referential: this council stops when it has AUDITED the floors, not when the parent has met them. The floor list is the dial (floors).

metadata.title: C-M10 micro-should-we-stop
metadata.notes: HUMAN-STOP: custom:floor_met_or_named == true | EDITABLE-DIALS: the producer text on the single stopping leaf, i.e. which parent floors are audited (floors) . budgets.time_minutes | NO-SOURCE-EXPRESSION: the custom leaf carries producer + note, which SEM-001 exact-equality forbids alongside source_expression; the HUMAN-STOP line is proven equivalent by _probe_lane1_presets.py | OUTCOME-MAP: PROCEED and STOP -> decision . DEFER -> no_decision | VOTING-MAP: design chair -> voting.method=synthesis_only with topology.chair and tie_break=chair | SELF-REFERENCE: this preset gates on auditing the floors, not on the parent meeting them, so it can never deadlock waiting for the council it is measuring | BINDING: advisory.
